0022600006.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Philadelphia 76ers, who are 1-0 after a road win, sit 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, and are on a one-game win streak. Cleveland won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season series 4-0, most recently a 115-101 win in Cleveland on March 9, 2026, and no games between the teams have been played yet this season. Cleveland is missing Nae'Qwan Tomlin (out, back), Jarrett Allen (day-to-day, knee, game-time decision), Khalifa Diop (day-to-day, knee), and Sam Merrill (day-to-day), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (out, back), and Tacko Fall (out, hip), with Dean Wade listed as day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision.
